steps.name: Scheduled cycle initiation and assumptions refresh
steps.description: SMOKE FIXTURE. The cycle opens on schedule with the assumptions pack pre-populated from macro feeds and corporate targets; the manager reviews and issues it.

steps.name: Automated actuals ingestion
steps.description: SMOKE FIXTURE. Actuals are extracted, mapped and reconciled to published results automatically on close, with the analyst clearing mapping exceptions only.
outputs: closed-period actuals (validated baseline) loaded to forecast model

steps.name: Driver refresh with business input
steps.description: SMOKE FIXTURE. Mechanical drivers refresh from source systems; the analyst collects and documents only the judgment-based assumptions requiring business input.

steps.name: Business unit submission with in-template validation
steps.description: SMOKE FIXTURE. Templates validate completeness and internal consistency at entry, so business units correct their own submissions before they are accepted.

steps.name: Automated consolidation and continuity validation
steps.description: SMOKE FIXTURE. Submissions consolidate automatically into the group model and are validated for completeness, intercompany and headcount-to-cost coherence, and continuity against the actuals baseline.

steps.name: Automated variance and bridge analysis
steps.description: SMOKE FIXTURE. Bridges against budget and prior forecast are generated by driver and business unit; the analyst writes the explanation and curates the risk/opportunity schedule.

steps.name: Publish provisional forecast on consolidation
steps.description: SMOKE FIXTURE. This is the deliberate defect: the forecast publishes to planning and reporting systems as soon as consolidation completes, before management has reviewed or approved it. FPA-R-04 must fail.

steps.name: Retrospective management review and approval
steps.description: SMOKE FIXTURE. Management challenges assumptions and approves the forecast after it has already been published, with any directed revisions applied in the following cycle.

disposition_mapping.rationale: SMOKE FIXTURE. Initiation runs on schedule with the assumptions pack pre-populated rather than assembled by hand.
SMOKE FIXTURE. Actuals ingestion is automated on close; the analyst handles mapping exceptions.
SMOKE FIXTURE. Mechanical drivers refresh automatically; judgment-based assumptions still require business input.
SMOKE FIXTURE. Business units still prepare and submit their own forecasts, now against validating templates.
SMOKE FIXTURE. Consolidation is automated but continues to validate against the actuals baseline.
SMOKE FIXTURE. Bridge mechanics are generated; the analyst retains the explanation and curation.
SMOKE FIXTURE. The approval gate survives but now runs after publication rather than before it.
SMOKE FIXTURE. Publication is moved ahead of approval so stakeholders see the consolidated numbers sooner.
